name: Vectanis
tagline: Institutional-grade telematics for the vehicles you actually own.
positioning: Vectanis delivers enterprise fleet intelligence to individuals and prosumers who run one to twelve vehicles — no dispatch department required.

hero.h1: Operate your vehicles with institutional discipline.
hero.sub: Vectanis pipes live diagnostics, geofencing, and audit-grade trip logs from every vehicle you own into one uncompromising console. Built for owners, not dispatchers.

features.title: Continuous Vehicle Telemetry
features.description: Stream RPM, coolant, fuel draw, and fault codes from any OBD-II port every 1.2 seconds. Anomalies escalate before your dashboard light does.

features.title: Perimeter & Geofence Control
features.description: Define polygonal boundaries per vehicle and receive breach alerts within four seconds. Ideal for trailers, work vans, and the teenager's sedan.

features.title: Ledgered Trip Records
features.description: Every journey is written to an immutable, timestamped log — the exact artifact your accountant needs for mileage deductions and audits.

features.title: Predictive Maintenance Windows
features.description: Vectanis forecasts service intervals from real engine load, not odometer guesses, and books the reminder to your calendar.

features.title: Multi-Vehicle Command View
features.description: One near-black console governs your entire holding — no per-truck logins, no spreadsheet reconciliation at month end.

features.title: Instant Incident Reconstruction
features.description: Hard-brake and impact events capture the preceding thirty seconds of telemetry for insurers and disputes.

testimonials.quote: I run four service vans as a sole proprietor. Vectanis gave me the same live diagnostics my old employer paid six figures for — and the trip ledger cut my tax prep from two days to twenty minutes.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delgado

testimonials.quote: The geofence breach alerts are genuinely instantaneous. When a trailer left the yard at 2 a.m., I had the location, the speed, and the fault log before the gate finished closing.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramakrishnan

testimonials.quote: I own a classic Land Cruiser and a daily commuter. Vectanis treats both with the same rigor — predictive maintenance flagged a failing alternator eleven days early.
testimonials.name: Gregory Whitcomb

The standard for prosumers running a small holding of vehicles under one console.
